name: 36703 · Selma, AL
findings: ZIP 36703 (Selma) has 38 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Political organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36703 (Selma) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36703 (Selma) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 41% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
